texto: 1. **Uso y significado**: equals Spanish «instead of / instead of + infinitive». It points to the alternative action that is discarded in favour of the main action carried out: **Statt das Auto zu nehmen, fahre ich mit dem Fahrrad** (instead of taking the car, I go by bike).

2. **Identidad de sujeto**: Like the other infinitive clauses, it is only used when the subject of the action performed and the one of the discarded match. If the subjects are different, the **statt dass**: **Er bezahlte alles, statt dass seine Freunde sich beteiligten** conjunction is used.

3. **Posición de la cláusula**: It can be placed before the main sentence (causing the required verbal investment in the main: **Statt zu schlafen, arbeitete er** = verb in position 1 of the main); or placed behind the main: **Er arbeitete, statt zu schlafen**.

filas: Statt zu schlafen, las er ein Buch.
Sie ging zu Fuß, statt den Bus zu nehmen.
Statt sich auszuruhen, ging er joggen.

frases.de: Fährst du heute wieder mit dem Auto ins Fitnessstudio?
frases.es: ¿Vas hoy otra vez en coche al gimnasio?
frases.en: Are you driving back to the gym today?

frases.de: Nein, statt das Auto zu nehmen, fahre ich heute mit dem Fahrrad dorthin.
frases.es: No, en vez de coger el coche, voy hoy en bicicleta hacia allí.
frases.en: No, instead of taking the car, I'm going on a bike over there today.

frases.de: Sehr vorbildlich! Und kochst du danach zu Hause?
frases.en: Very exemplary! And then you cook at home?

frases.de: Ja, statt im Restaurant teuer zu essen, bereite ich mir frisches Gemüse nach meinem Speiseplan zu.
frases.es: Sí, en vez de comer caro en el restaurante, me preparo verdura fresca según mi plan de comidas.
frases.en: Yeah, instead of eating expensive at the restaurant, I prepare fresh vegetables according to my meal plan.
analisis: statt im Restaurant teuer zu essen
instead of at the expensive restaurant to eat

bloques.pregunta: What function does the «statt … zu» structure play in a prayer?

opciones.texto: To present an alternative action discarded for the benefit of which is actually carried out
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts two incompatible options by highlighting the one that was not achieved.

opciones.texto: To express the necessary condition for the main action to be fulfilled
opciones.explicacion: The condition is formulated with «wenn», not with an alternative replacement clause.

opciones.texto: Indicate the cause or reason for a decision of the past
opciones.explicacion: Causality is introduced by «weil» or «da», not «statt … zu».

bloques.pregunta: When the «Statt … zu» clause precedes the main sentence, what happens to the verbal order in the main?

opciones.texto: Synthetic investment occurs: conjugated verb immediately passes to the first position after coma
opciones.explicacion: The complete subordinate clause occupies position 1, so the main verb goes in position 2.

opciones.texto: The subject of the main prayer is placed necessarily before the conjugated verb
opciones.explicacion: It would break the invariable German rule of position 2 for the verb conjugated in main prayers.

opciones.texto: The verb of the main prayer should be placed at the absolute end
opciones.explicacion: Only subordinate prayers carry the conjugated verb at the absolute end.

bloques.frase: ___ die dringende E-Mail sofort zu beantworten, löschte er sie versehentlich.

opciones.explicacion: «Statt ... zu + Infinitiv» points to the expected option discarded (respond) against the one that occurred (delete).
«Ohne» would express private mode («sin responder»), but with the alternative opposition «Statt» is used.
It would express an absurd purpose («para responder, la borró»).

bloques.frase: Er bleibt am Wochenende lieber zu Hause, statt in den Urlaub ___ .

opciones.explicacion: With «statt» the infinitive clause requires the «zu» particle («zu fahren»).
It is conjugated form of present, incompatible with infinitive construction.

bloques.pregunta: What attitude did the interested party take?
bloques.frase: Statt sich über das Problem zu beklagen, suchte sie aktiv nach einer Lösung.

opciones.texto: Buscó activamente una solución constructiva en lugar de lamentarse.
opciones.explicacion: «Statt sich zu beklagen» dismisses the unproductive complaint and highlights the search for solutions.

opciones.texto: He decided to file a formal complaint in writing before talking to his colleagues.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the meaning of «statt», which dismisses the complaint.

opciones.texto: He completely ignored the problem because he didn't have time to solve it.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase states that it actively sought an exit («suchte aktiv nach einer Lösung»).

bloques.frase: ___ sich am Feierabend auszuruhen, ging er noch zwei Stunden joggen.

opciones.explicacion: Introduce the action of discounted rest in front of the sports career performed.
It does not express the preferential alternative choice between two activities.
I would demand prayer with my own subject and conjugated verb to express purpose.

bloques.explicacion: statt zu fahren in position 1 + verb ging + subject er.

intro: To express a discarded alternative in favour of another action that is done, the German uses the infinite construction «statt … zu» (or anstatt).
